def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0]); s=[c for row in I for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==2][0]
    stop=min(s, W-1-s)
    B=s-2*stop+4
    O=[row[:] for row in I]  # keep original (2s stay)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if O[r][c]==2: continue
            if (r-c-B)%4==0 and r-c>=B: O[r][c]=1
    return O
for n in (1,2,3):
    p=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); e=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n, p==e)

import os,re,glob,json

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    G={}
    for p in glob.glob(d+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl'):
        t=open(p,errors='ignore').read().replace('\\n','\n')
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Focus on demo 6: which cells differ
I=G['Demo pair 6 input']; O=G['Demo pair 6 output']
H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
diffs=[(r,c,I[r][c],O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
print('demo6 diffs:',diffs)
